title: Solent Kestrels win NBL Playoff title
description: Team Solent Kestrels added the 2020-21 NBL Playoff crown to the NBL league title and L Lynch Trophy already in their possession with a commanding final display in Manchester. Coach of the Year Matt Guymon guided his team to a convincing 93-62 victory over third seeds Hemel Storm at the National Basketball Performance Centre behind a stunning scoring effort from guard Ian Smith (178-PG-96, college: Northern St.). The game MVP racked up 37 points off 57% shooting - which included 7-12 from three-point range - dished out nine assists and took 11 rebounds as the Kestrels capped another highly successful campaign. Orlan Jackman (201-F-88, college: Okla City) backed him up with 18 (9rbs), while Travis Charles (198-F-95, college: Albany) had 13 (9rbs).
